findings.title: get_monitor_environment_context returns unmodified config
findings.body: The function copies `monitor_environment.monitor.config` into a local `config` variable and mutates it (e.g. replacing `schedule_type` with its display string via `get_schedule_type_display()`), but the returned dict references the original `monitor_environment.monitor.config` instead of the modified `config`. As a result, the schedule_type value in the monitor context included with issue events is the raw enum/config value (e.g. `1`) rather than the human-readable display string (`Crontab`). The bug existed in `mark_failed.py` prior to this refactor and was carried verbatim; since this refactor splits the logic into a new module, fixing it now would correct the monitor context data shown to users in monitor incident events.

findings.title: Docstring typos and inaccurate singular example
findings.body: The docstring for `get_failure_reason` contains typos (`humam readible` should be `human readable`) and the singular example (`A failed check-in was detected`) does not match the actual output produced by `SINGULAR_HUMAN_FAILURE_MAP` (`An error check-in was detected`, `A missed check-in was detected`, `A timeout check-in was detected`). Since this refactor relocates the function into a new module, fixing the docstring now will prevent the mistakes from being propagated to anyone consuming the new module.
